title: Everyone takes a little more. Then there's nothing.
hook: Everyone takes just a little more. A few years later, nobody gets anything.
caption: Everyone takes a little more, then there's nothing. With {users} fishers each taking {greed_extra} more, the simulated lake collapses in year {collapse_year}; over {years} years the quota group catches {quota_catch} vs {greedy_catch}.

headline: A LITTLE
MORE
= NOTHING.

scenes.say: Everyone takes just a little more. A few years later, nobody gets anything.
The tragedy of the commons: the gain from taking more goes to you. The damage is shared by everyone.
Code runs a lake with {users} fishers. One version has quotas. In the other, everyone takes {greed_extra} more.
scenes.note: Simulation: logistic regrowth; quota = sustainable yield split evenly

scenes.say: With everyone taking more, the lake collapses in year {collapse_year}.
Over {years} years, the quota group catches {quota_catch}. The greedy group, only {greedy_catch}.
Everyone was rational. Together it was a disaster. That's why shared resources need rules.

takeaway: Everyone was rational. Together it was a disaster. That's why shared resources need rules.
